A light tower that moves with the music

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

17PULS-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    +GND3V3GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    +Supply input + · LED tower input 5V · Level shifter VCC · Controller VIN
    GNDSupply input - · LED tower input GND · Controller GND.2 · Level shifter GND · Level shifter 2A · Level shifter 1OE · Level shifter 2OE · Level shifter 3OE · Level shifter 4OE · Level shifter 3A · Level shifter 4A
    LED_DATAController D32 · Level shifter 1A
    LED_DATA_5VLevel shifter 1Y · 330 ohm data resistor 1
    LED_DIN330 ohm data resistor 2 · LED tower input DIN
    3V3Controller 3V3 · Microphone VDD
    GNDController GND · Microphone GND · Microphone L/R
    I2S_SCKController D26 · Microphone SCK
    I2S_WSController D25 · Microphone WS
    I2S_SDController D33 · Microphone SD
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
18PULS-WIRE-1

Puls is built

Puls is a half-metre tower of four LED strips behind diffuser channels, driven by an ESP32 running NightDriverStrip. A digital microphone in the controller box at its foot hears the room, and the tower answers each beat. It is for a living room or a party corner, powered by a certified 5 V desktop supply, and it runs custom effects mapped to its four faces.
